text_block_list.text:
While doing paperwork
in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Trainer-kuun, help me out here~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My head is pounding~.
I can't think straight at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, aren't you my assistant?
Please do something about this pain~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow... Even speaking hurts.
At this rate, I can't conduct proper research at all...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I can't even make painkillers, can I?
*sigh*... It's all over...

Agnes Tachyon looks to be in immense pain.
I should probably do something to help her.
